Washington Counties Risk Pool Law Enforcement Data Analytics
Description Of Opportunity
The Washington Counties Risk Pool (WCRP) is requesting proposals from all interested parties to provide a risk data analytics software solution and related implementation, training, support, and maintenance services. The WCRP is a self-insured, self-funded governmental risk management pool formed under RCW 48.62 and RCW 35.34.
